applicant_utility.summary: Chula LINK is only open to students already admitted to, or in their first semester at, Chulalongkorn University, so it cannot fund a new admission. If you qualify, you apply through a Google Form by 31 October 2026, after which the university runs a fixed calendar: faculty endorsements by 7 November, committee review 8-10 November, and results on the OIA website on 12 November. Neither the call page nor the timeline PDF publishes any monetary value for the tuition, allowance or airfare, so treat the money as unconfirmed until you sign a contract. Plan around a January 2027 semester start, since contract signing and visa processing begin from 12 November.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Non-Thai-passport Master's or PhD students already admitted to Chulalongkorn University who need tuition, living and airfare support for second semester AY2026.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you are admitted to or currently in your first semester at Chulalongkorn University
Confirm your passport is not a Thai passport
Submit the Google Form application before 31 October 2026
Prompt your faculty so its endorsement list is submitted by 7 November
Prepare for contract signing and visa processing from 12 November
Check the OIA website on 12 November for the announcement
common_rejection_risks: Failing to secure faculty endorsement by 7 November
Assuming the award is open to new applicants rather than admitted or current first-semester students
Holding a Thai passport, which the call explicitly excludes
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Not determinable from official sources: the published components are tuition fees, a monthly living allowance and round-trip airfare, but no amounts are stated, so the balance you must fund cannot be calculated from the award's pages
document_audit: The application itself is only a Google Form submission, so have enrolment and programme details ready
Faculty endorsement is out of your hands, so build the relationship before the deadline
Because no award value is published, request the contract terms before committing to semester expenses
